defects.title: Which types the final payload may have

a.quote:
> If you change the payload, you may only change it to a `string`, a
> `Buffer`, a `stream`, a `ReadableStream`, a `Response`, or `null`.

b.quote:
The type of the sent payload (after serialization and going through any
[`onSend` hooks](./Hooks.md#onsend)) must be one of the following types,
otherwise, an error will be thrown:

- `string`
- `Buffer`
- `stream`
- `undefined`
- `null`

defects.source: lib/reply.js:183-188 and the final send path accept web streams and `Response` objects without throwing.

defects.title: The value st_changed_on is capped at

a.quote:
Due to the 7 bit limitation, once a chunk has at least 127 samples,
   `st_changed_on` is set to 127 (0xEF) and the 127th and further samples will
   have `st_i` present.

b.quote:
Once a chunk has at least 127 samples,
`st_changed_on` is set to 127 (0x7F) and the 128th and further samples will
have `st_i` present.

defects.source: 127 is 0x7F; tsdb/chunkenc/st.go:19 has `maxFirstSTChangeOn = 0x7F`. The two passages also disagree on 127th versus 128th sample; the patch leaves that to the maintainers.

defects.title: The default of keepAliveTimeoutThreshold

a.quote:
* `keepAliveTimeoutThreshold` {number|null} A number of milliseconds
    subtracted from server *keep-alive* hints when overriding `keepAliveTimeout`,
    to account for timing inaccuracies caused by e.g. transport latency.
    **Default:** `2e3`.

b.quote:
* `keepAliveTimeoutThreshold` {number} A number of milliseconds subtracted from
    server _keep-alive_ hints when overriding `keepAliveTimeout`, to account for
    timing inaccuracies such as transport latency. **Default:** `1e3`.

defects.source: lib/dispatcher/client.js:311 uses 2e3 when the option is unset, and H2CClient passes it through unchanged; #3145 changed it from 1e3. types/client.d.ts:61 and types/h2c-client.d.ts:43 also still said 1e3. The same PR fixes the H2CClient pipelining default in types/h2c-client.d.ts:47, found while checking.
